text: Implemented storage/model seam under bead q-native-stored-completion: checked atomic BindCompletedArtifacts verifies completed nominal run/analysis/dataset, exact scientific recipe, compatible semantic source and existing canonical plan/result bindings; identical facts are idempotent and never promote shown run. Conditional studio.journal5 carries only the new command; previous pins unchanged, older writers/readers refuse it. ProjectSession owns exclusive writer-backed native archive store, prevalidates Running targets through a projected completion without history mutation, writes a future bound index, then reads and library-verifies actual stored bytes before returning facts. Backend-independent load bounds checked index entries/total declared bytes before content read and compares native facts with saved bindings; canonical input SHA remains in native typed facts, distinct from recipe semantic16 digest. Added checked-index RunStore.load overload to avoid budget reread race. Real tiny native storage tests cover source copies, journal/save/cold reopen, rejected scope, index failure/orphans/retry, budgets and explicit legacy-unbound collision.
